watches.name: Hellcat 36: Deep Purple
watches.description: A 36.5mm stunner. Stepped lugs, applied indices, anti-scratch coating on the caseback only* , a display caseback and a clasp with tool-less micro adjusts - the Hellcat 36 will pack many more surprises into the smallest Orion made yet. *Anti-scratch coatings are a type of PVD (physical vapor deposition) coating, which is a thin but hard coating. While this may offset the time before scratches show up and increase initial durability, it means the watch cannot be refinished. The curved and multi-finish caseback would be complex to refinish and I have found that they are quick to scratch because of how the clasp and bracelet sits on it when the watch is taken off and set down. The anti-scratch coating on the caseback is to keep the back looking fresh and resistant to bracelet scratches but not to sacrifice your option to have the watch refinished at a later date. Specifications: 36.5mm Diameter 18mm Lug Width 43mm Lug to Lug 9.9mm Thickness (incl. crystal) Screw Down Crown (upgraded tube design for increased security) 100m Water Resistance BGW9 Blue Lume Miyota 9039 Movement Display Caseback Sapphire Crystals Tool-less micro adjust clasp Wrist shot is is a 6.75” wrist Use of a springbar tweezer is recommended for installing and removing the end links

watches.name: Tesseract: Cerulean Blue
watches.description: THE TESSERACT: A 4 DIMENSIONAL HYPERCUBE Features a proudly made in America dial. The Tesseract pattern is entirely milled, providing tangible depth, relief, and sharp perpendicular corners. Each dial has a polished surface which is contrasted by the matte surface of the milled pattern. After galvanic treatment (coloring) of the dial, some are treated with a semi matte lacquer - some are not. The highly polished dials number in the single digits, with the remainder semi-matte. AMERICAN HOROLOGY The dials are polished by hand before CNC milling with end mills that measure a fraction of a millimeter in diameter. The nameplate, beset by two entirely functional and hand polished screws, is no small feat in itself. The chamfers feature anglage (done by hand) with a satin grain applied to the face. The nameplate is only 0.20mm in thickness (a dime is about 1mm thick) which means handling them requires a great deal of skill, lest they be damaged irreparably. The Orion text on the nameplate is the Orion typeface and is milled as well as inked by hand. Milling specific typefaces is a technical challenge and is seldom featured in watches; the alternatives being lasering the text or simply using the profile of the cutter to create a typeface. A deep rich blue, not unlike an errant cloud caught in a tranquil sunset or a calm sea. The expression of this dial is more hushed than the others. The cerulean blue dial is paired with white rhodium colored hands and nameplate. Technical Specifications Hand finished, made in America dial 39mm Diameter 20mm Lug Width 47mm Lug to Lug 10.5mm Thickness (Caseback to Crystal) Screw down crown 100m Water Resistance Movement: Miyota 9039 Crystal Material: Sapphire Lume: Blue BGW9

watches.name: Sylph: Burgundy
watches.description: The classic Sylph reimagined and refreshed. The burgundy dial is adorned with a sparkling silver printed rally track and text, atop the dial sit applied indices cut from stainless steel. The non cardinal indices are chisel shaped for that extra sparkle and added dimensionality. The hour and minute hands are faceted and diamond cut, so you can expect them to be exceptionally crisp and reflective. 39mm Diameter 20mm Lug Width 47mm Lug to Lug 10.5mm Thickness (incl. crystal) Screw down crown 100m Water Resistance Movement: Miyota 9039 Crystal Material: Sapphire Lume: Blue BGW9

watches.name: Hellcat: Burgundy S
watches.description: This model is discontinued and will not be restocked. Subtle change, big difference. The Hellcat you are no doubt familiar with is here again. This time the burgundy dial is appearing with silver printing on the dial, which offers high contrast and an exciting sparkle more dynamic than what a typically white ink would deliver. The silver reflects off the burgundy, elevating more scarlet hues than its rose gold counterpart. Limited to 50 pieces (25 date, 25 no date), potentially the final Hellcat variant. 39mm Diameter 20mm Lug Width 47mm Lug to Lug 10.5mm Thickness (incl. crystal) Screw down crown 100m Water Resistance Movement: Miyota 9039 or 9015 (no date vs. date) Crystal Material: Sapphire Lume: Blue BGW9 (note: the dial is not lumed)
